_comment: Example reviewed baseline for `aigrid-preflight`. Copy to a private location, review every value against what you intend the bot to run, then point AIGRID_APPROVED_CONFIG at your copy. Preflight is read-only: it never changes the running bot.

_meta.reviewed_by: REPLACE-ME (must be a human who owns the account)
_meta.note: max_entry_position_adjustment=-1 is required for multi-level grids; it is acceptable only because CapitalManager.max_position_size and the risk engine cap the resulting exposure in money terms. leverage is not exposed by the runtime API: 1x is asserted by policy and must be re-verified as trade.leverage == 1.0 at the first fill.
